'''Lu San''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] residing on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he accompanied [[Rej Taunt]] to [[Xifal]] to serve as an intermediary between Taunt and the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] so that Taunt could pick up an order of [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]]. During the visit, San was killed by the Colicoids during a feeding frenzy.<ref name="Millennium-Falcon" />
